activity.notes: Hans Egede arrived in Greenland on 3 July 1721 and led the Danish-Norwegian mission and colonial project until leaving Greenland in 1736. ATLAS does not treat him as a representative ruler of the Inuit/Greenlandic people; the represented polity is the Danish-Norwegian colonial establishment in Greenland.

sources.title: Hans Egede, 1686-1758 — Danmarkshistorien/Lex
sources.citation_text: Lex describes Egede as a Danish-Norwegian priest, missionary and colonizer, working in Greenland from 1721 to 1736 and leading the colonial project.
